feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 July 2026 11:32am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 02 July 2026 at 11:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the North Sea tracks eastwards, as high pressure to the southwest of Ireland builds a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

West or Northwest 5 or 6, decreasing mainly 3 or 4 early this afternoon, but remaining 5 occasionally 6 in the north and far east of the area. Decreasing 3 or 4 in all waters this evening, then backing Southwest tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, gradually falling slight by this evening.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, backing South or Southwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5 tomorrow afternoon, then increasing West or Southwest 4 or 5 occasionally 6 tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
